fusions.name: Herd Lash
fusions.desc: Casts a strand that deals 4 damage to one enemy within 7 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles (max 32%). Deals up to 1.5 times as much at maximum range.

fusions.name: Rallying Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps strands round you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Bed-Down
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Banked Warmth
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
